title: Top Perfumes to Gift & Wear (2026)
summary: 5 perfumes from editor-tested lists, each for a different taste: a sheer skin scent, a woody evening scent, a fresh citrus floral, a sweet gourmand and a long-lasting amber floral.
method: Picks come from Marie Claire UK's perfume guide (updated Sept 2026) and PureWow's guide to the best perfumes for women (updated Feb 2026). Scent notes, sizes and wear times are from those editors' reviews, and wear time varies by skin. We do not show prices in the text because they change. Both lists are editors' opinions, not lab tests, so smell a sample before you commit.
assumptions: the sources are women's perfume lists, but Marie Claire UK says scents should not be limited by gender, so any pick can be worn by anyone.

products.name: Glossier You Eau de Parfum
why: Both Marie Claire UK and PureWow list it, as a skin scent that smells a little different on every wearer.
Its notes are pink pepper, iris and ambrox, so it reads as sheer rather than loud.
products.desc: A sheer eau de parfum with pink pepper, iris and ambrox notes, sold in 0.27, 1.7 and 3.4 oz sizes. It is meant to smell different on each person, and it is not a strong, projecting scent.
products.benefit: Picture someone who wants to smell like clean, warm skin at the office rather than like a perfume. A PureWow editor wears it as a mild option when strong perfumes bother her, and Marie Claire UK notes it smelled soapy and warm on one editor but musky and powdery on a colleague. It is the only sheer skin scent in this guide. The catch: PureWow says it lasts about 5+ hours on skin, so expect to reapply.
pros: Smells slightly different on each wearer
cons: Hard to predict on you before you try it
Too quiet for people who want a scent that projects
products.best_for: People who want a mild, skin-like scent for every day.
products.skip_if: You want a scent that projects or lasts all day, because it is sheer and fades after about 5+ hours on skin

products.name: Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum
why: Both Marie Claire UK and PureWow name it a favorite, as a woody, powdery scent for evenings.
Notes include juniper berry, cedar, tonka bean and jasmine.
products.desc: A woody eau de parfum with juniper berry, cedarwood, tonka bean and jasmine notes. It comes in a single 2.4 oz (75 ml) bottle. It is not a light, fresh scent.
products.benefit: Picture a dinner or a night out where you want a deep, dark, woody scent that settles into the skin. PureWow calls it deep and smoky and good for nights out, while Marie Claire UK describes a powdery wood scent that works for day or night. It is the darkest, woodiest pick in this guide. The catch: it comes in one size only, so there is no smaller bottle to try first.
specs: Juniper berry, cedarwood, tonka bean, jasmine
pros: Powdery scent that melts into skin, per Marie Claire UK
Wearable by day too, per Marie Claire UK
cons: Dark and smoky, so a poor fit if you like fresh, light scents
products.best_for: People who want a deep woody scent for evenings and dinners.
products.skip_if: You prefer fresh or fruity scents, because this one is deep, dark and woody

products.name: Clinique Happy Eau de Parfum
why: PureWow's editor calls it bright, floral and citrusy, built on grapefruit, bergamot and mimosa.
It comes in 1.0, 1.7 and 3.4 oz sizes.
products.desc: A fresh floral eau de parfum with grapefruit, bergamot, mimosa and Hawaiian wedding flower notes. It comes in 1.0, 1.7 and 3.4 oz sizes. It is not a warm or heavy scent.
products.benefit: Picture a warm-weather day when you want something bright and citrusy that is easy to like. PureWow's editor describes a bright floral with citrus notes, and it is a long-running Clinique scent. It is the freshest, most citrus-led pick in this guide. The catch: PureWow says it may be too floral for fall and winter.
specs: Grapefruit, bergamot, mimosa, Hawaiian wedding flower
cons: May be too floral for fall and winter
A light style, so not a statement scent
products.best_for: People who want a bright, citrusy floral for spring and summer.
products.skip_if: You want a warm, deep scent for cold months, because this one is bright and floral
products.amazon_listing: Clinique Happy Eau de Parfum Spray | Notes of Grapefruit, Bergamot, Hawaiian Wedding Flowe

products.name: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Eau de Parfum
why: PureWow's editor describes a nutty scent from pistachio and almond, with warm salted caramel sweetness.
It comes in 0.27 and 1.7 oz sizes.
products.desc: A warm, sweet gourmand eau de parfum with pistachio, jasmine petals and salted caramel notes, in 0.27 and 1.7 oz sizes. It is not a long-lasting scent.
products.benefit: Picture a cozy evening in when you want a warm, sweet scent that smells like dessert. PureWow's editor describes pistachio and almond notes with salted caramel, rounded out by florals and woods. It is the sweetest, most food-like pick in this guide. The catch: PureWow says it fades after about six hours.
pros: Small 0.27 oz size for trying it
Also sold as a shower gel and deodorant, per PureWow
cons: Sweet, so not for people who like dry or fresh scents
products.best_for: People who like warm, sweet, dessert-like scents.
products.skip_if: You want a scent that lasts a full day, because it fades after about six hours
products.amazon_listing: Sol de Janeiro Perfume Cheirosa 62 Perfume Eau de Parfum | Long-Lasting Gourmand Vanilla P

products.name: Parfums de Marly Athénaïs Eau de Parfum
why: PureWow's editor says it lasts the longest of any perfume she has tried, even after a shower.
Notes include neroli, bergamot, jasmine, tonka bean and amber.
products.desc: An amber floral eau de parfum with neroli, bergamot, jasmine, tonka bean and amber notes, sold in one 2.5 oz size. It is not a budget buy and its sweetness is not for everyone.
products.benefit: Picture a long day from morning to late evening where you spray once and want it to stay. PureWow's editor reports 14+ hours of wear, sometimes even after a shower, with a citrus and jasmine opening over a powdery base. It is the longest-lasting pick in this guide by its reviewer's account. The catch: it has a high price point, and PureWow says the sweetness borders on coy.
specs: Neroli, bergamot, jasmine, tonka bean, amber
cons: Sweetness borders on coy, per PureWow
products.best_for: People who want one spray to last a long day.
products.skip_if: You are watching your budget, because it has a high price point

products.name: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum
why: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid is highlighted as a top floral perfume in Allure’s list of best floral perfumes.
It pairs classic orchid with vanilla, creating a sophisticated scent.
products.desc: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum is a floral perfume that blends orchid and vanilla notes. It is presented as a high‑quality fragrance with a 20% perfume oil concentration for better longevity.
products.benefit: Picture a woman who enjoys classic floral scents with a modern twist; she will appreciate the balanced orchid and vanilla notes that last long, making it a reliable choice for everyday wear. The fragrance offers a sophisticated scent that stands out among other floral options. It beats other picks in this guide by providing a more refined orchid profile and a longer lasting projection. The catch: it is priced higher than many other floral perfumes.
cons: Not suitable for very light scent lovers
products.best_for: Women who prefer a refined, long‑lasting floral perfume
products.skip_if: You are looking for a budget fragrance
products.amazon_listing: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid for Women 0.33 oz Eau de Parfum Spray |

products.name: Floral Street Wild Vanilla Orchid Eau de Parfum
why: Floral Street Wild Vanilla Orchid is mentioned in Refinery29 and Organic Beauty Lover reviews.
It is a sweet vanilla patchouli fragrance with a 20% perfume oil concentration.
products.desc: Floral Street Wild Vanilla Orchid Eau de Parfum is a floral perfume that combines vanilla and patchouli. It is marketed as a sweet, vanilla‑heavy scent with a 20% perfume oil concentration for better longevity.
products.benefit: Picture a young woman who loves sweet, vanilla‑heavy scents; she will enjoy the warm vanilla and patchouli blend that feels comforting. The fragrance offers a sweet, modern take on vanilla florals, making it stand out among other floral picks. It wins against other options by providing a stronger vanilla presence. The catch: it may be too sweet for those who prefer lighter floral scents.
products.best_for: Young women who enjoy sweet, vanilla‑heavy florals
products.skip_if: You prefer a subtle, classic floral perfume

intro: Eau de parfum holds 15-20% perfume oil, against 5-15% in eau de toilette, and Marie Claire UK says that gap is worth roughly six to eight hours of wear against two to four. All five picks here are eau de parfum, so they are built to last longer than a light cologne.

tips.title: 4 mistakes people make when buying a perfume
items: Buying before you smell it on skin.
PureWow suggests trying samples in store, and Marie Claire UK says to start with a blotter, then spray your wrist. Scents like Glossier You smell different on each person.
Marie Claire UK calls this a cardinal sin if you want the scent to last longer.
PureWow flags Clinique Happy as possibly too floral for fall and winter, while warmer scents like Cheirosa 62 suit cold evenings better.
Expecting every perfume to last all day.
Wear time varies: PureWow reports about 5+ hours for Glossier You on skin, about six hours for Cheirosa 62 and 14+ hours for Athénaïs.

faq: What is the best perfume for most people?
Glossier You is the safest first pick. Marie Claire UK and PureWow both list it, and it is a mild skin scent. It lasts about 5+ hours on skin.
Parfums de Marly Athénaïs. PureWow's editor reports 14+ hours of wear. It has a high price point and a sweetness that borders on coy.
What is a good evening perfume?
Diptyque Orphéon. Both Marie Claire UK and PureWow praise it as a deep, woody scent. It comes in one 2.4 oz size only.
What is the difference between eau de parfum and eau de toilette?
Marie Claire UK says eau de parfum has 15-20% perfume oil and lasts about six to eight hours, while eau de toilette has 5-15% and lasts about two to four.
Is there a fresh perfume for summer?
Clinique Happy, a bright citrus floral with grapefruit and bergamot. PureWow says it may be too floral for fall and winter.

verdict.line: If you want one perfume most people can wear daily, start here: both Marie Claire UK and PureWow list this mild skin scent. It lasts only about 5+ hours on skin, so expect to reapply.
